written_before_outcomes: writing started 2026-10-19T00:04:26Z (date -u), before any new real-label computation, fit or outcome of this campaign; no label read, no real-data fit, no label-reading loader called
implementation: tsz/rules.py (pure functions; load_rules() checks this file against the module constants); invented-data tests: python3 -m tsz.test_rules
status_of_every_rule: development rule on previously and adaptively used records; changes no original limit; the two-SE reserve is a development heuristic, not a new scientific cap or population guarantee; uncertainty statements are asymptotic and model-based
disclosure_known_values: the published source witness margins (results/pcrl_occupation_headroom_overnight_v1/WITNESS_SELECTION.json: A1_PO_16 minimum occupation-side ratio 4.30 on s1 guard|sex0, then 4.88 s0 guard|sex0, 5.57 s1 occupation accuracy) and the CTS1 training-size records (TRAINING_SIZE_BET.json, TRAINING_SIZE_CURVE.json) were known when every constant was chosen

original_limits.utility_clauses: income and occupation x U0_S<v> and Ucal_S<v> x accuracy loss, NLL excess (nats), summed Brier excess x versions 0 and 1: 24 clauses
original_limits.guards: within-SEX occupation summed-Brier excess vs U0_S<v>, men (sex0) and women (sex1), versions 0 and 1: 4 guards

versions.meaning: source seed v: references U0_S<v>/Ucal_S<v>, H3 income S<v>, H_LJ floor of seed v, procedure seeds of seed v
versions.independence: procedure repeats sharing every training row; never independent replications; never pooled

reserve.floor_reference: H_LJ MODEL_SELECT SE of the same condition and seed (copied unchanged from OHN1 reserve.floor.se)
reserve.se_used: max(own SE, floor SE x sqrt(5306 / households))
reserve.condition: margin = cap - value >= k x se_used (inclusive); ratio = margin / se_used
reserve.income: 12 income conditions per version inherited from H3; reported separately; never in the occupation-side reserve, the trigger or the strength rule

size_design.sign: change(a->b) = loss(b) - loss(a); improvement g = -change (positive = larger training set better)
size_design.estimator: household-clustered paired SE on MODEL_SELECT (cluster_se; subgroup_se for SEX groups), identical to ihs.evaluate
size_design.ordering_summary: mean over 4 orderings; SD_ord (df 3); se_eval = sqrt(mean s_o^2); se_comb = sqrt(se_eval^2 + SD_ord^2 / 4); one fit: se_comb = own SE
size_design.margin_pattern_rule: met100 = W100 meets the occupation-side reserve on both versions; n50 / n70 = cells of 8 (ordering, version) meeting it; FULL_NOT_REPRODUCED if not met100; FULL_ONLY if met100 and (n50 < 8 or n70 < 8); ALL_SIZES if met100 and n50 = n70 = 8

interpretation_rules.IR1: FULL_ONLY: full-data refitting reproduces the margin while smaller fits lose it; the previous reduced-training experiment did not settle full-data feasibility
interpretation_rules.IR2: FULL_NOT_REPRODUCED: inspect exact implementation and exposure differences; no retuning
interpretation_rules.IR3: an ordinary equally exposed control explains the gain (CONTROL_EXPLAINS_GAIN or CONTROL_ALSO_MEETS_RESERVE)
interpretation_rules.IR4: uncertainty leaves the size explanation unresolved

encoding_sensitivity.fits: A1_PO_16 at S50(o), v = 0, o = O0..O3, admitted full-MODEL_FIT dictionary vs FIT-only dictionary
encoding_sensitivity.sign: E_o = loss(FIT-only) - loss(admitted); positive = admitted dictionary better

trigger.evaluated_at: once, at task-stage close, before any correction fit

parts.T0: both versions of W100 evaluated; 28 finite conditions per version; H3 income hash equals the admitted wire
parts.T1: both versions: 6 occupation point caps and 2 within-SEX guards (inclusive)
parts.T2: both versions: all 8 occupation-side conditions meet the reserve (k = 2, OHN1 H_LJ floor), via ohn.rules.reserve
parts.T3: both versions: deployed package from the six raw fields reproduces the stored W100_v release bitwise on every evaluated role and every registered refusal check passes (verifier record)

secondary_non_gating_record.role: second record by the coordinator's tsz.deploy check; non-gating; a disagreement with the verifier record is reported and blocks the trigger until resolved, never by relaxing a check

trigger.excluded: income conditions, smaller subsets, controls, readers, reproduction status; nothing relaxed after outcomes

correction.recipe: ohn.protect.train_correction, guard 'none', one full pipeline per arm; release r_s = softmax(log p_W + s x Delta_arm)
correction.guard_none_targets_rule: the fixed constant above (the original guard cap) in every outer fold and in the full pipeline; theta must be bitwise invariant to targets under guard 'none' (invented-data check)
correction.cont_rule: CONT is evaluated at the selected strength of the arm it matches; no own selection

selection.information: nested 10-fold household cross-fitting of MODEL_FIT (tag TSZ1_ncv10); every upstream layer refitted inside each outer fold (witness, its cross-fitting base, routing, LOC and PAIR corrections); per-person increments vs s = 0 pooled over 20,000 people
selection.nested_cont: optional (only if the compute budget allows), descriptive, never gating
selection.allowance_definition: a_j(v) = lambda x min over conditions mapped to j of the OHN1 H_LJ floor SE of version v
selection.pass_test: for all 5 statistics: estimate + z x SE <= allowance (inclusive); non-finite fails; negative estimates allowed
selection.selected: largest s such that every nonzero strength <= s passes (fixed sequence); identity if the smallest nonzero strength fails
selection.non_monotone: the sequence stops at the first failure; a later pass is never selected (flag PASS_AFTER_FAIL)
selection.identity: always admissible and stored as the selected release
selection.disclosure: pooled cross-fitted cost estimates target reduced-size submodels and do not guarantee the deployed 100% model's costs

readers.benefit_sign: comparator SCORE AUC - candidate SCORE AUC (pair view; positive = candidate read less)
readers.recipient_sign: candidate SCORE AUC - comparator SCORE AUC (income and occupation views; <= 0.010 every cell)
readers.spread: d_v = mean of version v's 4 cells; v_rep = SS / (n_eff - 2) with SS = sum over DISTINCT cells of (b - d_v)^2 (a (v, R) pair whose k0 and k1 cells are equal enters once); n_eff = 4 + number of (v, R) pairs with b(k0) != b(k1); v_samp = mean of the 8 squared cell SEs; sd_total = sqrt(v_rep + v_samp); identical to the source screen when n_eff = 8
readers.k_differs: per (v, R): b(k0) != b(k1), exact float comparison
readers.genuinely_effective: the grid passed the effective-seed check AND the comparison's qualifier is READER_SEEDS_EFFECTIVE_ALL_PAIRS; only then may a result be described as holding across reader seeds; the qualifier never changes the label
readers.forbidden_seed_formula: MODEL_SEED_BASE + 300 + 10 v + k for v in {0, 1}, k in 0..9 (OHN1 / CTS1 grid seeds); MODEL_SEED_BASE = 2026101205

comparators.eligibility: original point feasibility only (24 clauses + 4 guards, published values); kept even if they fail the reserve
comparators.equal_reserve: the same 28-condition and 16-condition reserve applied identically to candidates, controls and references; qualified iff minimum ratio >= 2 on both versions

claims.C2: UTILITY_PRESERVED_BOTH_VERSIONS / UTILITY_PRESERVED_ONE_VERSION / UTILITY_NOT_PRESERVED / NO_NONZERO_SELECTION (per arm; point limits AND occupation-side reserve; used by the closure rule)
claims.C2p: UTILITY_POINT_PRESERVED_BOTH_VERSIONS / UTILITY_POINT_PRESERVED_ONE_VERSION / UTILITY_POINT_NOT_PRESERVED / NO_NONZERO_SELECTION (per arm; original point limits only, 12 + 2 per version = 24 + 4; reported beside C2, never used for closure)
claims.every_selected_release: point status and occupation-side reserve status reported separately for every selected release, identity included, both versions
claims.C3: RECOVERY_BELOW_CONTINUATION iff STABLE_POSITIVE vs CONT at the same strength
claims.C4: RECOVERY_BELOW_LOCAL_CORRECTION (PAIR only) iff STABLE_POSITIVE vs LOC at LOC's own selected strength
claims.C5: COMPETITIVE_WITH_ALL_REQUIRED iff 24 + 4 at the point, old per-cell recipient gate vs all six, STABLE_POSITIVE vs all six
claims.C6: DEV_GRID_TARGET_STABLE / DEV_GRID_TARGET_POINT_ONLY / DEV_GRID_TARGET_NOT_MET vs NEURAL_RAW and H_LJ
scope: Occupation-only optimization is not a new two-output joint method.
Lower recovery for declared readers is not arbitrary-reader protection.
Do not claim a population learning curve, independent replication or proof that size caused every historical difference.
reader recipes and overlapping splits are not independent datasets
